answer: Rule: identity slots are priced on a bonding curve tied to the funding graph. The first identity from a funding cluster costs 100 POA; the tenth costs 10,000 POA, because price rises with the square of identities already issued from that cluster. At dawn each epoch the registry publishes the curve, so a sybil farm sees its horizon clearly: 100 fakes cost 1,000,000 POA, not 10,000. One copper token buys one slot; the curve buys the economy. Missed audits slash the whole cluster stake.
